justifications.evidence: Every headline number reproduces from the reviewed run's own persisted receipts, independently recomputed here. All twelve map_relative_sup values (diverted exact 0.01870561466/0.01947331852/0.009409275576; diverted legacy 0.1973269787/0.3617057713/0.0861086001; limited exact 1.232031106e-05/7.088280122e-05/3.262176223e-05; limited legacy 0.001183492741/0.001160890025/0.001184138473), the booking_image_relative_sup and exterior_closure_relative_sup columns, the serialized_executable_bytes, cold_compile_seconds and warm_execute_seconds columns reconcile to the report's printed precision. The four fitted orders reproduce exactly from row pitch_m and errors (diverted exact map 0.543915019 / booking 1.507930205; diverted legacy 0.59143395 / 0.512869607; limited exact -0.981414592 / -0.973853475; limited legacy 0.001812486 / 0.001766192), as do the first-cells<=0.01 thresholds (diverted exact 5158; limited both arms 553; diverted legacy none). The positive control is exact (legacy 550 diverted positive_control_relative_delta 0.0 against the ladder's 0.197327). The shifted-support control fires (0.9104266182 > 0.01870561466). The booking+exterior decomposition reconstructs the measured residual to a maximum of 1.138e-15 across all rows, tighter than the report's claimed 1e-10. The guard control is shown to refuse (read polygon fraction error 7.6e-8 accepted, 0.5 refused with GUARD_REFUSAL). The report's two reconciliation claims are verified: the log named limited-550-legacy-exact-1283120.log does carry CASE=diverted CELLS=5000 (so its 2,156,136,745-byte refusal is correctly excluded), and the six read-arm discrepancies quoted (2.57e-8 to 8.89e-8) are present as READ_POLYGON_FRACTION_ERROR in the cited logs. Not higher only because the read-arm discrepancies live in logs rather than in the refusal receipts, and the coverage audit receipt was written at revision dcb4076156 rather than at head (immaterial, since it is a coverage gate over the run directory).
justifications.fit: Report conventions are followed: it leads with the verdict as the brief item (6) demands; a support-and-booking contract precedes use of the three arms; provenance gives the receipt path, revision and H200 job id for all twelve rows; method-level non-claims are explicit ('map evaluations at the analytic state; no fixed-point solve or tangent is claimed'); refusals and unavailable values are disclosed rather than hidden; the residual decomposition is decomposed into booking and exterior with per-rung domination stated. The figure follows the repository data-ink style (no gridlines, no title; verified absent in the SVG) and the fragment figcaption states the encoding and the read-arm absence. Kept from full marks by a dense, run-on opening verdict paragraph and by the refusals table's dual use of one log filename for two nominal arms, which makes that table harder to read than the underlying facts warrant.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node's goal is to measure whether the certificate forward map converges with cell count once its plasma support is right, comparing three support arms (legacy fixed-design support, the new topology read, and the exact analytic support) for the limited and diverted cases at about 550, 2,000 and 5,000 realised cells. The delivered report answers that question for two of the three arms and for neither completely in a positive sense: the diverted exact-arm map is nonmonotonic (0.0187056147 at 550, 0.0194733185 at 2098, 0.00940927558 at 5158) with a fitted map order of 0.543915019 that does not establish convergence, the diverted legacy arm is 0.197326979/0.361705771/0.0861086001 and never reaches the 0.01 bound, and the limited case is at or below 0.01 for every measured row (exact 1.232e-5/7.088e-5/3.262e-5, legacy ~1.18e-3) but is itself nonmonotonic. Done-when items (1) support-contract, (2) positive control, (6) verdict and dominant-term decomposition are met. The read arm — the comparison the plan section 2 pivot is actually about, 'is accuracy carried by the read once the support is right' — delivered 0 of 6 rows, so item (3)'s three-arm ladder is two-arm only and item (4) carries no read-arm order. That central comparison is undelivered, though disclosed and, per the coordinator's recovery advice, explicitly ruled a finding not a defect to repair here. The exact/legacy ladder that was delivered is complete across both cases and all three rungs and answers the booking-versus-exterior question, so the deduction is for the missing arm rather than for a thin deliverable.
justifications.reuse: Reuses the repository's existing machinery rather than adding a solver: benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py with its analytic oracles, the ladder prototype's fixture cache read in place without writing into it, nova.equilibrium.topology.read with TopologyPolicy for the read arm, and the certificate map/booking path for all arms. The rung-ordered single-allocation H200 pattern is followed (one job looping its rows, each row persisted as it lands) and the persistent compilation cache is disabled before compile. New machinery is confined to the prototype driver, geometry/guard helpers, report builder and audit under scripts/prototypes/support; no product signature changed.
justifications.scope_discipline: The reviewed diff base 50ec68c949b7151ff9d2744e996dc48e0314e83f..head c165fdfd4626dddbf1218fdaa2fce0ed768794da adds exactly the declared paths: seven files under scripts/prototypes/support (audit.py, geometry.py, guard.py, ladder.py, measure.py, report.py, run.sh), the figure docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/proto-support/map-convergence.svg, and four lines in the fragment docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/proto-support.html; 3,295 insertions, no deletions and no file under nova/ or tests/ touched, as the brief requires of prototype code. The report is at its granted external path in the run directory. Deducted for one out-of-scope item: the reviewed worktree carries an untracked root-level audit.py outside the declared write path (see finding 2).
